title: Digital twin manifest (one per person)
description: Blocks marked (audit) were added 2026-10-28 from the anatomy audit (docs/anatomy-audit-batch1..8). All are optional so pre-audit manifests stay valid; Tier-A manifests SHOULD populate them from imaging/clinical assessment, never from camera/LiDAR inference.

segmentation_reviewed_by_clinician.description: Required true for Tier A (3D Slicer gate, docs/accuracy.md)

built_with.description: Upstream catalog slugs, ideally with pinned commits from catalog/pins.json

spinopelvic_parameters.description: (audit, Batch 1) Spinopelvic parameter layer - parameters, not models. Imaging-sourced only (EOS/CT/MRI/radiograph); never surface-inferred.

limb_alignment.description: (audit, Batches 2/6) Per-side bony alignment and segment lengths, imaging-measured (e.g. Torsion Tool). Drives personalised joint axes; camera estimates must not populate this block.

muscle_parameters.description: (audit, Batches 4/7) Per-muscle parameter groups, fitted as three SEPARATE groups - weakness (force), contracture (passive), spasticity (reflex gain). Reflex gains only from instrumented clinical assessment (controlled-velocity stretch + EMG/force), never from video.

fat_fraction_pct.description: MRI Dixon PDFF fat fraction (MS-03 pipeline)

force_scale.description: Weakness group: multiplier vs generic model (1.0 = generic)

passive_stiffness_scale.description: Contracture group: multiplier vs generic passive stiffness

optimal_fiber_length_scale.description: Contracture group: multiplier vs generic optimal fibre length

reflex_gain.description: Spasticity group: velocity-dependent reflex feedback gain; only from instrumented assessment

bone_quality.description: (audit, Batch 6) Bone-quality inputs are exo SAFETY inputs: they derate assistance torque. Imaging/clinical-sourced only.

diagnosed_conditions.description: e.g. osteoporosis, osteogenesis imperfecta, Paget disease - clinician-recorded

exo_torque_derating_factor.description: Multiplier applied to assistance-torque limits; set by clinician/safety owner (D-05)

devices_and_prostheses.description: (audit, Batches 2/4/6/8) Implant, prosthesis and orthosis device blocks. The twin models the device as body segments/joints with these parameters.

safety_flags.description: (audit, Batches 6/8) Clinician-set flags that RESTRICT twin behaviour (protocol ROM limits, prohibited actuation, exo derating). The twin never sets or clears these itself.

restrictions.description: e.g. 'no end-range neck flexion/rotation', 'no neck actuation', 'exo torque derated 50%'

note.description: unrepresentable-anatomy covers e.g. syndactyly/polydactyly hands the parametric model cannot draw (Batch 6 honesty rule)

body_state.description: (audit, Batch 4) Time-varying or population body-parameter sets layered over the base twin.

age_parameter_set.description: Older-adult applies age-adjusted muscle parameters (reduced force, slowed activation)

parameter_set_at.description: Segment mass/CoM/inertia set follows the pregnant-woman model by trimester
